messages:
Leo (Sales): Quick handoff — Springboard signed yesterday, 50k ARR, want dedicated capacity in Q2. PV: needs SSO + private VPC.
Alex R: congrats team. main risks?
Leo (Sales): two big ones: 1) compliance review wants KMS + audit logs, 2) a hard SLO on latency for realtime scoring. they asked about burst capacity too.
Priya S: noted. Do we have an estimated GPU footprint from Sales?
Leo (Sales): they expect ~150 concurrent requests at peak, avg seq len ~1k tokens. Sales gave rough number of 4 x A10s initially.
Marta C: thanks. I'll start a provisioning ticket. need IAM contacts + ATO checklist from their security team.
Alex R: owner for rollout = Priya for onboarding, Marta for infra provisioning, Jae for eng escalation if model quality issues. Can we get a timeline?
Priya S: timeline proposal: week 0 — contract handed over + credentials; week 1 — provision VPC & KMS; week 2 — staging deploy & smoke tests; week 3 — perf tuning and canary; week 4 — go-live. is that OK?
Leo (Sales): customer expects soft go-live in 5 weeks but would take a 4-week plan. they can be flexible by a week.
Marta C: blocker: SSO metadata from their IdP. requested yesterday, not yet received. pinging Leo to chase.
Leo (Sales): pinged them this morning. asked for SAML metadata and a primary security contact, cc'd their devops.
Jae L: heads up on the latency SLO — if they require <100ms p99 for generation we should consider model quantization + KV caching. I'll prepare a perf checklist and a fallback plan (smaller model + regional routing).
Priya S: noted. we should also capture evaluation prompts and baseline generation quality. Leo, can you provide top 10 representative prompts?
Leo (Sales): yes — sending in a separate email to Priya with samples.
support-bot: Created ticket CS-4721: "Springboard private deploy — provisioning & SSO" assigned to Marta C. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4721 :white_check_mark:
Marta C: added an infra action item: request to infra-team to reserve 4 A10-equivalent slots in us-west1 for week 2.
Alex R: risks for renewal? anything that could delay first invoice or cause churn at 90 days?
Leo (Sales): renewal risk low but watch performance and SSO delays. they tie ROI to 30-day latency stats. if we miss that they'll push timeline.
Priya S: capture feedback loop: create a shared doc for prompts + evals, set weekly triage for first 6 weeks, and add an alert for p99 latency > 200ms.
Jae L: I'll add a runbook for graceful degradation: fallback model + throttling + customer-visible "degraded mode" banner.
Marta C: will open a support escalation contact card and add network lead to CS-4721.
Alex R: next steps summary: 1) Leo -> submit IdP metadata + prompt samples (today) 2) Marta -> provision tickets + reserve capacity (by EOD tomorrow) 3) Priya -> create eval doc + schedule weekly triage (by tomorrow) 4) Jae -> perf checklist & runbook (48h).
Leo (Sales): on it.
Priya S: tagging for visibility @Marta C @Jae L @Alex R :thumbsup:
Marta C: thanks all. will update CS-4721 with timelines and owners.
support-bot: CS-4721 updated: status = "In Progress".
Alex R: closing the thread for now — ping here with any blocking items. :rocket:
